stem: What made the battles at Antietam and Gettysburg different from the other battles illustrated on this map?

options.label: F
options.text: They were victories for the Confederacy.

options.label: G
options.text: They were battles fought in Union territory.

options.label: H
options.text: They were attempts to keep Virginia in the Union.

options.label: J
options.text: They were battles defending the Confederate capital.
